events.verdict: Wiggins (OKC) makes contact to the ball and incidental contact with Schroder's (SAC) hand on the ball as he pursues the rebound. Schroder loses his balance as a result of contact with his teammate, Sabonis (SAC).
LaVine (SAC) initiates illegal contact to Hartenstein's (OKC) arm during the play at the basket.
Sabonis (SAC) obtains a position in Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path and the contact is incidental as they come together.
Wiggins (OKC) is late to the spot and initiates body contact with LaVine (SAC) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Hartenstein (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it away from Sabonis (SAC).
Westbrook (SAC) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) briefly engage and disengage off of the ball.
Sabonis (SAC) firms up in a screening position and the ensuing contact with Caruso (OKC) is marginal.
DeRozan (SAC) directly contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Gilgeous-Alexander's hand after the release.
Sabonis (SAC) establishes a screening position in Mitchell's (OKC) path and absorbs the contact.
Sabonis (SAC) maintains a hand on Mitchell's (OKC) back and the contact is marginal as Mitchell jumps in the opposite direction of the rebound.
